dialogues.jp: ドン――
dialogues.en: Thud...
dialogues.text: Thud...

dialogues.en: "Oof!"
dialogues.text: "Oof!"

dialogues.jp:
落下というか、大きな手でベッドに押し付けら
れたような衝撃で目を覚ます。
dialogues.en:
I wake up from the impact of falling on my bed, or perhaps I
should say by being pushed down by somebody's big hand.
dialogues.text:
I wake up from the impact of falling on my bed, or perhaps I
should say by being pushed down by somebody's big hand.

dialogues.jp: 「あ……あのババァ……」
dialogues.en: "Oh, that old lady..."
dialogues.text: "Oh, that old lady..."

dialogues.jp: ぐぐっ、と顔を上げながら｛うめ／呻｝く。
dialogues.en: I growl while lifting my head.
dialogues.text: I growl while lifting my head.

dialogues.jp: あれは、あきらかに普通の夢ではなかった。
dialogues.en: That was not an ordinary dream at all.
dialogues.text: That was not an ordinary dream at all.

dialogues.jp:
見せられたのではなく、あの場にいた感触が身
体にこびりついている。
dialogues.en: I still remember the exact feeling when I was in the dream.
dialogues.text: I still remember the exact feeling when I was in the dream.

dialogues.jp:
ぐるり、とうつぶせから仰向けになって、ふぅ、
とため息をつく。
dialogues.en: I breathe a sigh rolling over on my back.
dialogues.text: I breathe a sigh rolling over on my back.

dialogues.jp: 「……やっぱり生きてたのか？」
dialogues.en: "Was she really alive?"
dialogues.text: "Was she really alive?"

dialogues.jp: それはバカな考えだ。
dialogues.en: That is ridiculous.
dialogues.text: That is ridiculous.

dialogues.jp:
俺は確かに、ばあちゃんの入った棺桶が、火葬
にされる瞬間を見ていたのだ……。
dialogues.en:
I saw the moment when the casket that grandma was inside was
cremated.
dialogues.text:
I saw the moment when the casket that grandma was inside was
cremated.

dialogues.jp:
白い煙になって、長い煙突から細長い帯になっ
て、空に立ちのぼる光景を見ていた。
dialogues.en:
I saw the white smoke that went up to the sky through the
chimney like a slim fabric.
dialogues.text:
I saw the white smoke that went up to the sky through the
chimney like a slim fabric.

dialogues.jp: そして重たい鉄の扉が開いて……。
dialogues.en: Then, the heavy door opened...
dialogues.text: Then, the heavy door opened...

dialogues.jp: 胸騒ぎがして跳ね起きる。
dialogues.en: I spring to my feet, feeling a sense of panic.
dialogues.text: I spring to my feet, feeling a sense of panic.

dialogues.jp: ざわざわ。
dialogues.en: Buzz.
dialogues.text: Buzz.

dialogues.jp:
不快な羽虫の集まったような塊が、胸の中と耳
元でざわつく感覚。
dialogues.en:
I feel like there are a bunch of bugs flying at my ears and
inside my chest.
dialogues.text:
I feel like there are a bunch of bugs flying at my ears and
inside my chest.

dialogues.jp: まるで春の嵐のような耳鳴り。
dialogues.en: There's a harsh sound, like a spring storm.
dialogues.text: There's a harsh sound, like a spring storm.

dialogues.jp:
現実にも風が強いのか、窓辺まで張り出した桜
の木が上下に揺れながらガサガサと泣いている。
dialogues.en:
I think it's windy outside, the cherry tree at the
windowsill is swaying around and making a crying sound.
dialogues.text:
I think it's windy outside, the cherry tree at the
windowsill is swaying around and making a crying sound.

dialogues.jp: 「……泣いている？」
dialogues.en: "Crying?"
dialogues.text: "Crying?"

dialogues.jp: 耳がおかしくなったのか。
dialogues.en: Something must be wrong with my ears.
dialogues.text: Something must be wrong with my ears.

dialogues.jp:
木の音はあくまでガサガサ、といった梢の音な
のに、どうして泣いているなんて……。
dialogues.en:
That's just the sound of rustle of a tree, I don't know why
I said crying.
dialogues.text:
That's just the sound of rustle of a tree, I don't know why
I said crying.

dialogues.jp: 『女の子が泣いてるのよ？』
dialogues.en: 'A girl is crying?' That's what Grandma said.
dialogues.text: 'A girl is crying?' That's what Grandma said.

dialogues.jp: 「女の子？」
dialogues.en: "A girl?"
dialogues.text: "A girl?"

dialogues.jp:
もしあれが普通の夢でないのなら、その言葉は
本当なのだろう。
dialogues.en:
If that was not an ordinary dream, then the word must be
'real'.
dialogues.text:
If that was not an ordinary dream, then the word must be
'real'.

dialogues.jp: バカらしい夢だ。
dialogues.en: What a stupid dream.
dialogues.text: What a stupid dream.

dialogues.jp: 一笑に付して寝てしまおうか。
dialogues.en: I could laugh it away and go to sleep.
dialogues.text: I could laugh it away and go to sleep.

dialogues.jp: そんな考えが頭の片隅をよぎる。
dialogues.en: The thought goes around in my head.
dialogues.text: The thought goes around in my head.

dialogues.jp:
いや……そんな考えが、頭の片隅にしかよぎら
ない。
dialogues.en: No... actually, the thought goes around only in my head.
dialogues.text: No... actually, the thought goes around only in my head.

dialogues.jp: 「女の子」
dialogues.en: "A girl..."
dialogues.text: "A girl..."

dialogues.jp: それは――、
dialogues.en: It must have been...
dialogues.text: It must have been...

dialogues.jp: ◆泣き虫なあの子……◆
dialogues.en: ◆Crybaby...◆
dialogues.text: ◆Crybaby...◆

dialogues.jp:
夢から追い出された俺は、なにか胸騒ぎを感じ
た。
dialogues.en: I felt a bad feeling after being kicked out of my dream.
dialogues.text: I felt a bad feeling after being kicked out of my dream.

dialogues.jp:
『女の子が泣いてるのよ？』という言葉に、俺
が思い浮かべた少女は――。
dialogues.en:
When I heard 'a girl is crying', I first remembered the girl
I know, who is...
dialogues.text:
When I heard 'a girl is crying', I first remembered the girl
I know, who is...
